name: caldav-to-ics
description: Republish CalDAV and ICS calendars as read-only .ics feeds (full or busy-only) behind secret URLs, on Cloudflare Workers.

SOURCES.description: JSON array of calendars to publish, e.g. `[{"type":"caldav","url":"https://caldav.example.com/","username":"me@example.com","password":"app-password"},{"type":"ics","url":"https://example.com/calendar.ics"}]`. See the [README](https://github.com/zupolgec/caldav-to-ics#sources).

FULL_TOKEN.description: Secret part of the full calendar URL. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Leave empty to turn the full feed off.

BUSY_TOKEN.description: Secret part of the busy-only calendar URL (times only, no details). Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Leave empty to turn the busy feed off.

REFRESH_MINUTES.description: How often the calendars are read again, in minutes (minimum 2).

PAST_DAYS.description: How many days of past events to include.

CALENDAR_NAME.description: Calendar name shown in calendar apps.

BUSY_TITLE.description: Title of every event in the busy-only feed.

OWNER_EMAILS.description: Optional, comma-separated: your email addresses. Invitations you declined are left out of the busy-only feed.
